assessment.report:
# Tiered test execution close assessment

The approved bounded change is written in the existing test-acceptance contract as the sole tier/reuse/resource-policy owner. Complete coverage and manual/E2E mapping remain separate from each iteration's selected execution. Explorer may perform directed evidence discovery once behavior/module boundaries are identified; Tester judges assertions, coverage, selection and results. Lead manages existing user authority only. New paid/external effects or hard-budget expansion require the user.

The Lead inspected the actual coherent delta against the captured dirty 0.9.4 baseline. Existing canonical lines, repair references, bilingual 0.9.4 changelog histories and architecture are preserved. Changed route wording extends existing policy rather than replacing repair/acceptance guards. Explorer changes only developer_instructions; profile/model/effort/sandbox are unchanged. The documentation runtime's literal kitVersion is declarative provenance only. Both complete public-language baselines and changed release sections were reviewed for equivalent meaning; source 0.9.5 is a patch preview, not installed or promoted stable.

Tester executed the seven selected current-source native/doc/bilingual/package/fake-home/documentation/stage checks once on coherent inputs. All exited 0, temporary fixture roots were removed and the exact fake home was independently checked absent. The installer verified all agent/Skill payload and receipt hashes and version 0.9.5. Reviewer independently inspected actual source and reachable results, matched canonical provenance and found no material issue; no unnecessary duplicate suites were run. Source walkthroughs cover TE-01 through TE-12 and independent raw dirty/auth/DB-state/budget/assertion histories. They do not establish actual Agent adherence or measured savings. All manual/runtime E2E cases remain pending in the active packet, and no exception waives them.

The optional skill-creator helper freshly failed before validation due to missing yaml; it is unavailable, not passing. No dependency was installed. The actual native/package checks and semantic review provide only their stated evidence. No scheduler/cache engine/framework, schema, production seam, test weakening or architectural refactor was added. Existing architecture suffices. Other historical scopes are preserved and not re-certified; no active PRD/OpenSpec authority applies.

Actual task children are /root/test_scope_explorer (fresh team-explorer), /root/repair_guard_writer_v2 (reused original team-docs-maintainer), /root/concurrency_tester (reused original team-tester), and /root/tiered_test_reviewer (fresh team-reviewer), all complete. No spawn failures, generic-role substitution or recursive children occurred in this task. Selected profiles/handles are actual invocation evidence, not confirmed loaded model identities; unreported metadata remains unknown. Lead reconciles this task's current governance only. No commit, push, real Codex installation, global configuration mutation or ECC access occurred. Manual acceptance and unavailable helper remain transparent limitations.
